headerDisplay: Panamax M4320-PRO Power Conditioner Plugin for Homebridge
footerDisplay: Control multiple Panamax M4320-PRO and M4315-PRO units over local TCP / Telnet. All configured units are published together under 1 Child Bridge when child bridging is enabled.

name.title: Platform Name
name.description: The name for this platform instance in Homebridge.

_bridge.title: Child Bridge
_bridge.description: Optional Homebridge Child Bridge settings (managed via Bridge Settings in Homebridge UI).

name.title: Device Name (Required & Unique)
name.placeholder: e.g., AV Rack 4320, Living Room Power
name.description: A unique, identifiable name for this Panamax hardware unit.

id.title: Unique Identifier (Optional)
id.description: Optional unique ID used to maintain persistent HomeKit pairing if IP or name changes.

host.title: IP Address / Hostname
host.description: Local network IP or hostname of the Panamax BlueBOLT card.

pollInterval.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to poll outlet status to keep Apple Home in sync. Default is 10 seconds.

accessoryMode.title: HomeKit Accessory Mode

oneOf.title: Unified Device (Recommended: 1 accessory tile containing 8 outlets)
Individual Accessories (Separate accessory tile per outlet)

accessoryMode.description: Unified Device mode presents 1 clean physical accessory in Apple Home and Homebridge with 8 outlet services. In Apple Home, you can choose to view them as a single tile or separate tiles.

enableAllOutletsSwitch.title: Expose Master All-Outlets Switch
enableAllOutletsSwitch.description: Adds a master switch to toggle all outlets ON or OFF simultaneously.

enableRebootButtons.title: Expose Reboot Buttons
enableRebootButtons.description: Adds stateless switches for triggering Panamax Reboot 1 and Reboot 2 sequences.

items.helpvalue: Outlet Configuration: If left empty, all 8 outlets will be published with default names (e.g. Outlet 1..Outlet 8). You can customize individual names, disable unneeded outlets, or change whether they appear as Outlets or Switches in Apple Home.
